lead: Software a person owns or licenses for their own computer and phone, organised by what it does; everyday tools are kept to market leaders and test winners, creative and hobby tools are explored product by product (product → major version → edition).

b.v: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android, web
b.w: The first test for any program.

b.v: open source · free · free with paid extras · one-time licence · subscription
b.w: Shoppers filter on this after platform.

b.v: e.g. Windows 11 Home / Pro; Office Home 2024 / Microsoft 365 Family
b.w: How makers sell and how support ends; editions are types, not kinds.
Download libraries and testers flag this.

depts.note: Tier for everyday utilities; variety for Linux distributions, hobby operating systems and emulators.

b.v: years of security updates left on the major version
b.w: End-of-support dates published by each maker.
Editions differ in encryption, remote desktop and management features.

s.brief: Desktop OS as product → major version → edition (Windows 1.0 … 11 with Home/Pro; macOS by version name; ChromeOS). Split Linux distributions and hobby/alternative systems out of k9 into their own kinds with archetypes (originating distro → derivatives as versions). Trim server-only hypervisors and research emulators (SIMH, GXemul, XenServer) from virtual machines. Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.

k.brief: Keep Windows, macOS, ChromeOS families as archetypes with major versions and editions; move distros and hobby OSes to the next two kinds.
Archetypes by lineage: Debian (Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS), Red Hat/Fedora, Arch (Manjaro, EndeavourOS), openSUSE, Slackware, Gentoo, NixOS; desktop-environment flavours as types.
BSDs on the desktop, Haiku, RISC OS, ArcaOS, AmigaOS/MorphOS, ReactOS, SerenityOS, FreeDOS.

s.brief: Hobbyist kinds. Game emulators organised by emulated system family with the reference emulator per system as archetypes (MAME, Dolphin, RetroArch as front end, PCSX2, DuckStation, Cemu, Ryujinx/Yuzu lineage, DOSBox, VICE, WinUAE, ScummVM). Mod managers: Vortex, Mod Organizer 2, Nexus Mods App, Thunderstore.

Restraint: ≤8 market-covering brands per kind plus test winners; editions into types; flag PUP-prone tools in the definition only if sourced. Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.
Restraint: trim to market brands; image, file and sync backup as types; drop enterprise migration tools (User State Migration Tool) unless consumer-facing.

Restraint: trim to current market leaders and built-in OS tools; dual-pane, CLI and OS file managers as types; remote desktop trims to personal-use tools (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Chrome Remote Desktop, built-ins). Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.

depts.note: Pick the right kind and a lab-tested product; editions (free, internet security, total security) are types.

b.v: AV-TEST certified → AV-Comparatives Advanced/Advanced+ → Product of the Year; SE Labs AAA
b.w: Protection, performance and false-positive tests by independent labs.
How VPNs and password managers prove their claims.
Family plans vary widely.

s.brief: Restraint plus test winners: cut k1's 87 SKUs to one entry per vendor (≈10–12 vendors) with editions as types; add vendors that top AV-TEST, AV-Comparatives or SE Labs results, sourced from retrieved result pages. Drop server and gateway products (AVG Linux Server Edition, Forefront TMG, UserGate).
Restraint: ≤8 market-covering products per kind; editions and family plans as types; drop enterprise/OEM tools (Knox, SecuBox) and command-line duplicates.

depts.note: Suites and single apps for documents, planning, language and household money.

b.w: The main reason people pick a suite.
Microsoft 365 vs Office Home 2024, Acrobat Standard vs Pro.

s.brief: Product → major version → edition for the market leaders (Microsoft Office/365, Apple iWork, Google Workspace apps, LibreOffice, WPS Office, OnlyOffice; Acrobat Reader/Standard/Pro). Trim legacy and research tails (Andrew, CA-Cricket Presents, AppleWorks) to icons; Brainshark, Google Cloud Vision, AnyDoc are trade—drop. Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.

Restraint: k36 (134 models) trims to personal and small-team task apps; enterprise project-portfolio tools (RiskyProject, Jira-style trackers) out; online whiteboard stays a kind with no models unless the old data has some.
Restraint: trim SDK/medical/business SKUs (AmiVoice SDK, Medical) and cloud APIs (Amazon Polly, IBM Watson, Amazon Translate) to consumer products.

Restraint: personal and sole-trader/small-business products only; enterprise accounting (QuickBooks Enterprise, Apache OFBiz) and tax-professional suites (ProConnect, ProSeries) out; staff-monitoring time trackers out.

depts.note: Browsers, mail and downloads, AI assistants, and add-ons to other software or devices.

b.w: Main differentiator among browsers and AI assistants.

s.brief: Restraint: k110 (165) trims to engine-covering browsers (Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi, Samsung Internet) plus notable privacy ones; engine (Blink, Gecko, WebKit) as types. Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.
Restraint: consumer products only; developer frameworks (Langflow, CrewAI) and enterprise search (Glean) trimmed.
Restraint: one entry per add-on, not per host; trim to widely used items.

depts.note: Tier for everyday apps; variety for creative tools people compare and learn (product → major version → edition).

b.w: Matters for file exchange and jobs (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign vs Affinity, GIMP, Krita).
A long-running community debate since Creative Cloud (2013).

s.brief: Archetypes: Photoshop (major versions 1.0 → CS → CC; Elements as separate archetype), GIMP, Affinity Photo, Paint.NET, Pixelmator; Lightroom/Lightroom Classic, Capture One, darktable, DxO PhotoLab for RAW; Midjourney, DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Firefly for AI images. Creative suites: Adobe Creative Suite/Creative Cloud, Affinity, Corel. Discontinued products (dead tails) are trimmed unless they are icons of their kind; whole-kind historic items live on the Classic software shelf.

Add digital painting as a kind (Procreate, Clip Studio Paint, Krita, Corel Painter, Rebelle, Paint Tool SAI, Photoshop brushes as cross-link). Vector: Illustrator, FreeHand (historic icon), CorelDRAW, Inkscape, Affinity Designer, Sketch; DTP: InDesign, QuarkXPress (icon), PageMaker (historic), Affinity Publisher, Scribus. Template design apps tier (Canva, Adobe Express).

Hobbyist and maker tools: 3D modelling (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, ZBrush; sculpting/rendering as types), CAD (AutoCAD, Fusion, SolidWorks, FreeCAD, SketchUp, Onshape, Tinkercad), slicers (Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer, Chitubox), laser/CNC control (LightBurn, LaserGRBL, Easel, Carbide Create), PCB (KiCad, EAGLE, Altium), photogrammetry (Meshroom, RealityCapture, Polycam), embroidery digitising (Hatch, Embrilliance, Ink/Stitch). Survey-grade/defence photogrammetry (SOCET SET) and MEP/building-services CAD out.

depts.note: Tier for screen capture and converters; variety for editors, effects and animation.

b.w: iMovie/Clipchamp → Premiere Elements/PowerDirector → Premiere Pro/Final Cut Pro/DaVinci Resolve/Avid Media Composer.

s.brief: Archetypes with major versions and editions: Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro (and Final Cut Express historic), DaVinci Resolve (free/Studio), Avid Media Composer, Vegas, iMovie, CapCut; effects: After Effects, Nuke, Fusion, Motion; 2D animation: Toon Boom Harmony, Adobe Animate (Flash lineage), OpenToonz, TVPaint, Moho; stop motion: Dragonframe, Stop Motion Studio; screenwriting: Final Draft, Fade In, WriterDuet, Celtx, Highland. Converters stay tier (HandBrake, FFmpeg).
Restraint: trim to market leaders and built-ins (OBS Studio, Snagit, ShareX, Snipping Tool, Bandicam); recording vs streaming as types.

depts.note: Variety for making music (DAWs, notation, voicebanks); tier for players and readers. Plug-ins have their own department.

b.w: Editions cap tracks, instruments and effects.
Decides which plug-ins run.

s.brief: Rename k75 to Digital audio workstation; archetypes Pro Tools, Logic Pro (Notator lineage), Cubase (Pro/Artist/Elements), Ableton Live (Intro/Standard/Suite), FL Studio, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig, GarageBand. Notation (k77 has no models): Finale (historic, discontinued 2024 to verify), Sibelius, Dorico, MuseScore, LilyPond, Notion. Add guitar tablature (Guitar Pro, TuxGuitar, Power Tab) and music-learning apps (Yousician, Melodics, Simply Piano, ear trainers). Singing synthesis: Vocaloid engine versions plus voicebank archetypes (Hatsune Miku), UTAU, Synthesizer V, CeVIO. DJ: rekordbox, Serato DJ, Traktor, VirtualDJ, djay. Show control stays kind-level, trimmed (QLab, Show Cue System). Audio editors: Audacity, Adobe Audition, iZotope RX cross-link, Sound Forge.
Restraint: trim dead players to icons (Winamp, iTunes) and current leaders (VLC, foobar2000, MusicBee, Plex/Kodi-style players, Apple Books, Kindle app); DVD/Blu-ray player suites as types.

depts.note: Plug-ins that run inside a DAW; organised kind → archetype (plug-in or emulated hardware) → version, with makers in a developer register (Native Instruments, Spectrasonics, Arturia, u-he, Xfer, FabFilter, Universal Audio, Waves, Soundtoys, Valhalla DSP, iZotope, Spitfire Audio, Toontrack, Neural DSP, Antares, Celemony…).

b.w: Must match the host DAW.

b.v: none · licence key · iLok · online activation
b.w: A frequent buyer complaint.
Sample libraries need disk space and RAM; analogue emulations need CPU.

s.brief: Every kind gets archetypes ordered by significance and every maker a developer-register brand entry. Synths: Serum, Massive (X), Omnisphere, Sylenth1, Diva, Pigments, Vital, Arturia V Collection emulations (Minimoog, Jupiter-8, DX7 etc. as archetypes of the emulated hardware). Samplers: Kontakt, EXS24/Sampler, HALion, Decent Sampler. Orchestral: Spitfire BBC SO/LABS, EastWest Hollywood Orchestra, Vienna Symphonic Library, Orchestral Tools. Keys: Keyscape, Pianoteq, Ivory, Addictive Keys. Drums: Superior Drummer/EZdrummer, BFD, Addictive Drums, Battery. Reassign k121's mixed items (Myth, Zyklop are synths; Flux items to effects).

Kinds by processor type with hardware-emulation archetypes where the community names them (LA-2A, 1176, SSL bus compressor, Pultec EQP-1A, Lexicon 480L, EMT 140 plate, Echoplex). Developers: FabFilter (Pro-Q, Pro-C, Pro-L), Valhalla (VintageVerb, Supermassive), Soundtoys (Decapitator, EchoBoy), UAD, Waves, iZotope (Ozone, RX, Neutron), Antares Auto-Tune, Celemony Melodyne, Neural DSP and IK Amplitube amp sims, Tokyo Dawn, Xfer OTT/LFO Tool. Redistribute k125's current models into the right kinds.

depts.note: Software for collections, family history, home planning, radio, the night sky and data.

b.w: Lets years of records outlive the program.

s.brief: Collection cataloguing (CLZ, Libib, Delicious Library historic, Discogs app cross-link) restrained to leaders; add genealogy (Family Tree Maker, RootsMagic, Legacy, Gramps, MacFamilyTree; GEDCOM as type), home & garden design (Sweet Home 3D, Home Designer/Chief Architect, Planner 5D, garden planners), ham radio (WSJT-X, fldigi, N1MM Logger+, Ham Radio Deluxe, logging/digital-mode/SDR as types).

Planetarium (Stellarium, SkySafari, Cartes du Ciel, Celestia, KStars; planetarium-dome systems like Digistar out). Add astrophotography (PixInsight, DeepSkyStacker, Siril, N.I.N.A., SharpCap, APT). GIS: QGIS, Google Earth Pro, ArcGIS Pro; transport-modelling and enterprise GIS servers out. Scientific: R, MATLAB, Mathematica, SPSS, Stata, Python/Jupyter distributions, GeoGebra, Origin; trim 142 to ≈12.

depts.note: Tools a person installs to write code, make games and manage their own machines; servers and enterprise tooling are out of scope.

b.w: First filter for editors and engines.
Game engines differ sharply (Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker).

s.brief: Code editors/IDEs: Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio (Community/Pro/Enterprise), JetBrains IDEs, Xcode, Vim, Emacs, Sublime Text, Notepad++, Cursor. Game engines as hobbyist variety: Unity, Unreal Engine (major versions), Godot, GameMaker, RPG Maker (editions), Construct, PICO-8, Ren'Py, Twine, Adventure Game Studio; in-house studio engines (4A Engine etc.) trimmed. Compilers/runtimes: one per language family (GCC, Clang/LLVM, MSVC, .NET, JDK, Python, Node.js); drop internal components (RyuJIT, CoreRT). Version control: Git, Mercurial, Subversion plus GUI clients. Web design: Dreamweaver lineage, WordPress-style builders, Webflow; historic GoLive/PageMill/iWeb as icons only.

Restraint: k97 becomes desktop/personal databases (FileMaker, Microsoft Access, LibreOffice Base, SQLite tools); database servers out. Terminals, SSH/FTP clients and network analysers trimmed to leaders (Windows Terminal, iTerm2, PuTTY, WinSCP, FileZilla, Wireshark); surveillance and appliance products out.

depts.note: Kinds whose heyday has passed, kept for collectors of boxed software and people running it on vintage machines or emulators.

b.w: Collectors value complete boxed copies; period and platform are attributes.

s.brief: Historic shelf: After Dark (Flying Toasters) and Windows/XScreenSaver lineages for screen savers; CD-ROM reference works (Encarta, Grolier, Britannica CD, Microsoft Bookshelf); home publishing (The Print Shop, PrintMaster, Print Artist); P2P clients (Napster, Kazaa, LimeWire, eMule, Soulseek). Archetypes with era and maker; no title lists of entertainment.

drop.why: ERP is institutional business software (findings: trade out).
Point-of-sale runs shops and restaurants: trade.
UML/software modelling suites are enterprise trade tools.
Web and application servers are server/trade software.
